what: A thin line for one grid row — the top horizontal line is folded at the left end and unfolds toward the right, while each cell’s left vertical line and the row’s right end line are folded at the top and unfold downward, once the row’s top edge rises above 98% of the screen they all unfold at once (.9s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1)). Cell lines start .06s later per cell, and the end line .15s later, so the row looks drawn from left to right — stack several rows and the dividers of the lower rows are drawn anew each time you scroll

options.start: How far up the screen (in %) the line’s top edge must rise before it opens, default 98
options.--fx-edge-delay: Delay for the line’s right-end edge, default .15s
options.--fx-bleed: Length the top horizontal line sticks out past the row (left/right outer margin), default 0
options.[data-fx-part=cell]: Row cells — draws a left vertical line on each cell (direct children of the row)

note: Uses the ::before and ::after of rows and cells as lines — the user must not place other decoration in the same spot

from.where: every .k-row in index.html·product.html — original .fk-g.fk-lh(::before scaleX · ::after scaleY .15s · .fk-c::after var(--d)=i×.06s, .9s var(--e1), top edge < Screen 98%)
